interactions.note: The epitope of Fab A13-D6.3 on the core fragment of PrV envelope glycoportein H ectodomain was determined from the crystal structure. The disordered regions in the gHC structure are the N-terminal segment of 34 amino acids (107–130), five internal loops (198–210, 448–450, 469–482, 543–546, and 603–607) and the C-terminal five residues that connect to the TM region (634–639). There are two complexes in the asymmetric unit in which antigen-antibody contacts differ. Therefore they are curated as different assays.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.05 angstroms

The epitope specific mAb A13-D6.3 bound to recombinant PrV gHE/gL heterodimer (where gHE denotes the full-length ectodomain of gH), as shown by size exclusion chromatography. MAb A13-D6.3 did not stain wild type PrV, but bound to variant ΔgL-pass virions, indicating that the epitope is not (or poorly) accessible in the wild type.
